column1: Cap the maximum volume level (protects your ears / headphones).
Left/right channel balance. 0 = centred; negative = left, positive = right.
Send audio to the digital SPDIF output instead of the internal DAC. Playback pauses for a moment while it switches.
Screen backlight level. While Outdoor Mode is on the screen stays at full brightness.
Colour theme for the whole interface. Each has dark and light screens (see Appearance).
Dark or light screens. Changing it redraws the screen in a moment; music keeps playing.
Size of list and body text: Small, Medium or Large. Titles and clocks keep their size. The screen redraws in a moment.
Turn the picture and touch clockwise: Normal, 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Stored by the player, as in the stock menu.
Light screens at full brightness, easier to read in sunlight. Uses more battery. Turning it off returns your own brightness.
Show each song's track number in album lists.
Songs with no cover of their own get one from the internet (Wi-Fi). Each album is looked up once; playback is never touched.
Songs with no lyrics of their own (no .lrc file, none in the song's tags) are looked up on lrclib.net (Wi-Fi). Off stops diskOS's own lookup; lyrics from the SD card or the song's tags still show.
Choose which tiles appear in the pull-down Quick Settings drawer.
Album art style on the Now Playing screen.
How the Albums list looks: a text list, or a cover flow you flick through.
Now Playing accent: derived from album art, or any fixed colour you pick.
Pre-decode album art so covers load instantly. Background decoding can warm the player; it throttles on heat.
Idle time before the clock screensaver appears and the screen dims.
Screensaver look: Cover art, Analog clock, Minimal, Digital, or spinning Vinyl.
How long after the screensaver the screen turns fully off.
Use a 24-hour clock instead of AM/PM.
The colour of the Disc drawn on the startup screen. Set it to match yours.
Show the weather glance on the home screen and screensaver (tap it to open the full forecast). Off skips the background fetch to save battery.
Swipe distance needed to go back. Lower is more sensitive.
Scan for and connect to Wi-Fi networks.
Pair Bluetooth devices. Audio routes to connected headphones or speakers (SBC, beta).
Codec for Bluetooth headphones, as in the stock player. Applies the next time the headphones connect. If they lack the codec, SBC is used. AAC and LDAC are heavier for this player and may stutter.
Interface language. Song, artist and album names are always shown as they are tagged.
Pause playback, or shut the device down (see When Sleep Ends), after this long. Resets on restart.
What the Sleep Timer does. Shut down closes the card safely first, then powers the device off.
Power the device off after this long with nothing playing and no touch or key press. Closes the card safely first.
The player's Charging optimization: stops charging at about 80% to slow battery wear.
What the volume keys do on a single press: adjust the volume or switch track. Stored by the player, as in the stock menu.
What the volume keys do on a double press: adjust the volume or switch track.
What the volume keys do when held: adjust the volume or switch track.
Re-scan the SD card for new or removed music.
Import .m3u / .m3u8 playlists found on the SD card.
Which UI boots by default. To boot the other one, hold Vol-Up from power-on until it appears.
Set the time and time zone from the internet whenever Wi-Fi connects. A change applies after the next restart.
Set the clock by hand. With Automatic Time on, Wi-Fi may correct it later.
Automatic follows your location when Wi-Fi connects (with Automatic Time on). Pick a zone to set it yourself.
Restart the device. Boots your default UI; hold Vol-Up for the other one.
Model, stock firmware, diskOS build, MAC addresses, storage and battery.
Look for a file on the SD card named like a stock update and show how it is used. Information only: diskOS never runs it.
Look up the newest diskOS release on GitHub (needs Wi-Fi). If it carries a signed update, download and verify it, then restart to finish. Nothing changes until you confirm.
Put diskOS's look and behaviour settings back to defaults. Music, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Last.fm, EQ and audio settings are kept.
Enable temporary SSH over Wi-Fi (fresh random password) for debugging. Off by default.
Battery/board temperature from the fuel gauge (this SoC exposes no core sensor).
